name: ckz_eff2500_layerfilter
_design: Native lora_layer_filter (exclusion: matched layer-name substrings get the adapter DISABLED). Probe which MODULE TYPE carries cKz timbre, on the DEPTH/module axis the time-gate couldn't touch. LoRA layers live on self_attn / cross_attn / ff across 24 blocks. Arms: control(all on); off self_attn; off cross_attn; off ff; LoRA ONLY on ff (off self+cross); LoRA ONLY on self_attn (off ff+cross). If timbre survives with LoRA only on ff -> timbre=ff, and attention=base may free melody = the decoupling we want. Fixed prompt, 2 seeds. Run with CKZ_GATE_DEBUG=1 to print disabled-layer counts.
